title: GitHub - j-sofia/Scout: Scout, a self-hosted Discord memory bot. Listens to the conversation and creates summaries and answers questions
excerpt: Scout, a self-hosted Discord memory bot. Listens to the conversation and creates summaries and answers questions - j-sofia/Scout
content_html:
Private, local meeting memory for Discord voice.

Scout is a self-hosted Discord bot that joins an authorized voice channel, keeps speakers separated by Discord identity, transcribes English speech locally, and turns the conversation into durable, searchable meeting memory. Raw audio and verbatim transcripts are deleted after each checkpoint is safely compacted.

No audio, transcript, summary, prompt, embedding, or conversation metadata is sent to a hosted AI service. Discord still carries normal bot messages and voice traffic; all AI inference and retained conversation data stay on the Windows computer running Scout.

Important

Scout is pre-1.0 software. The local application and automated tests are implemented, but every deployment must pass a real Discord/DAVE voice acceptance test in the target server before it is used for meetings.

Why Scout

  • Local by design. Whisper, Qwen, retrieval, storage, and question answering run on the owner's machine with no AI API key.
  • Faithful attribution. Discord's per-user voice streams preserve speaker IDs; Scout does not guess speakers with diarization.
  • Bounded retention. Two-minute checkpoints retain structured memory, not a hidden permanent transcript. Retention defaults to 30 days.
  • Grounded answers. Answers come only from the selected session's retained memory and include approximate time ranges. Missing details stay missing.
  • Local voice questions. During a session, say “Hey, Scout,” wait for the boop, and ask a question. Scout uses the same grounded current-session query path, posts the answer, and speaks only the direct answer in the voice channel with a local Kokoro neural voice.
  • Inspectable operation. A loopback-only dashboard shows session, queue, model, GPU, disk, and retention health without publishing conversation content.
  • Failure-safe cleanup. Temporary inputs are removed only after the replacement compact memory is validated and committed.

How it fits together

flowchart LR
    D["Discord voice"] -->|"per-user Opus"| N["Node.js sidecar"]
    N -->|"attributed PCM over authenticated loopback"| P["Python coordinator"]
    P --> W["faster-whisper"]
    W --> C["Qwen3 via loopback Ollama"]
    C --> S["SQLite compact memory"]
    S --> A["Grounded answers and summaries"]
    P --> U["Owner dashboard on 127.0.0.1"]
Loading

The Node.js adapter owns the Discord gateway, application commands, DAVE voice receive, and PCM decoding. Python owns lifecycle, transcription, compaction, retrieval, storage, retention, and the administrative dashboard. See the architecture decisions for the reasoning behind these boundaries.

Requirements

Scout currently targets one owner-operated Windows 11 machine with:

  • Python 3.12 (the pinned release does not support Python 3.13);
  • an NVIDIA GPU suitable for large-v3-turbo with CUDA/FP16 (the reference system uses an RTX 4080 SUPER with 16 GB VRAM);
  • Ollama for Windows, bound to loopback;
  • a Discord application and bot token;
  • the pinned Kokoro v1.0 FP16 local voice model (installed by scout warm-models);
  • enough local storage for models, temporary work, and retained summaries.

The checked-in helper downloads a pinned portable Node.js 24 runtime for the Discord sidecar. A machine-wide Node.js installation is not required.

Quick start

git clone <your-fork-or-repository-url>
cd Scout
py -3.12 -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -e ".[all]"
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\get_node_runtime.ps1
sidecar\.tools\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node.exe sidecar\.tools\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js --prefix sidecar ci
ollama pull qwen3:8b
scout warm-models
scout doctor
scout run

Open http://127.0.0.1:8765. The first visit creates the local dashboard password. Then follow the Discord bot registration guide to set SCOUT_DISCORD_TOKEN and configure the owner, guild, voice channel, and output channel. Full native setup, packaging, and benchmark instructions are in the Windows guide.

Scout can start while a prerequisite is missing, but it will report the problem and will not accept a recording until capture and inference are healthy.

Discord commands

Command Purpose
/scout start (join) Join the caller's voice channel and start a session
/scout stop (leave) Finalize the active session early
/scout status Show content-free session and pipeline health
/scout summary [session] Build an overall summary from compact memories
/scout ask <question> [session] [scope] Ask a grounded question
/scout sessions List sessions available in the current guild
/scout export [session] Export retained summary and metadata locally
/scout correct [session] Add an audited correction

Voice activation is enabled by default and can be disabled in the local dashboard. The phrase “Hey, Scout” must be the speaker's entire utterance; saying “Scout” alone, mentioning Scout in a sentence, or putting a question after the wake phrase does not activate it. After the boop, that speaker has 20 seconds by default to begin the question, and other speakers cannot take over the pending interaction. Wake detection uses the configured local Whisper model, so the release performance benchmark must be rerun with realistic conversational turn frequency. Before either a spoken question or /scout ask searches an active conversation, Scout creates a durable checkpoint through the latest captured audio so the answer uses current retained memory. The posted text keeps approximate retained-time evidence; spoken playback reads only the direct answer. Kokoro runs through ONNX Runtime CUDA on the GPU, with voice and speed configurable in the dashboard. Windows SAPI remains an explicit local fallback; Scout does not silently fall back to CPU or switch engines automatically.

Privacy and consent

Scout visibly joins the voice channel and posts a local-transcription notice before recording. It uses notice and implied consent; participants who do not want to be included can leave. Recording laws differ by location, so the operator must confirm that this model is lawful wherever Scout is used.

Data Location Lifetime
Discord voice and messages Discord transport Governed by Discord plus live session needs
Raw audio and verbatim transcript Local temporary work area Until a checkpoint is durably committed
Wake/question clips and synthesized answer audio Local temporary work area Deleted immediately after local inference/playback
Compact memory and presence events Local SQLite database 30 days by default, configurable
Models Local disk Until the owner removes them
Content-free operational logs Local disk Local retention policy

Runtime data defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Scout. The dashboard binds only to loopback, requires a password, and protects state-changing actions with CSRF tokens. Guild IDs remain part of every session and retrieval boundary.

Development

Unit tests need neither Discord nor a GPU:

python -m pip install -e ".[dev,audit]"
python -m pytest
python -m ruff check .
python -m mypy
python -m pip_audit --local --progress-spinner off
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\check_public_release.ps1

Node sidecar tests run with the downloaded portable runtime:

sidecar\.tools\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node.exe sidecar\.tools\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js --prefix sidecar test

The performance release gate uses four synthetic speakers and a three-hour-class session; see Windows setup. Real conversations and generated fixtures must never be committed.

Contributions are welcome. Start with CONTRIBUTING.md, read the project constraints in AGENTS.md, follow the Code of Conduct, and report vulnerabilities according to SECURITY.md.

License

Scout's source code and project artwork are available under the MIT License. Third-party packages and model artifacts keep their own licenses; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Discord, Ollama, Qwen, Whisper, and the referenced product names are trademarks of their respective owners.

blocks.html_en: Voice activation is enabled by default and can be disabled in the local dashboard. The phrase “Hey, Scout” must be the speaker's entire utterance; saying “Scout” alone, mentioning Scout in a sentence, or putting a question after the wake phrase does not activate it. After the boop, that speaker has 20 seconds by default to begin the question, and other speakers cannot take over the pending interaction. Wake detection uses the configured local Whisper model, so the release performance benchmark must be rerun with realistic conversational turn frequency. Before either a spoken question or /scout ask searches an active conversation, Scout creates a durable checkpoint through the latest captured audio so the answer uses current retained memory. The posted text keeps approximate retained-time evidence; spoken playback reads only the direct answer. Kokoro runs through ONNX Runtime CUDA on the GPU, with voice and speed configurable in the dashboard. Windows SAPI remains an explicit local fallback; Scout does not silently fall back to CPU or switch engines automatically.

content_html_zh:
用于 Discord 语音的私人本地会议内存。

Scout 是一个自托管的 Discord 机器人，它加入授权的语音通道，通过 Discord 身份将发言者分开，在本地转录英语语音，并将对话转换为持久的、可搜索的会议记忆。 每个检查点安全压缩后，原始音频和逐字记录将被删除。

不会将音频、文字记录、摘要、提示、嵌入或对话元数据发送到托管 AI 服务。 Discord 仍然承载正常的机器人消息和语音流量；所有 AI 推理和保留的对话数据都保留在运行 Scout 的 Windows 计算机上。

重要的

Scout 是 1.0 之前的软件。 实施了本地应用程序和自动化测试，但每次部署都必须在目标服务器中通过真正的 Discord/DAVE 语音验收测试，然后才能用于会议。

为什么选择侦察兵

  • 本地设计。 Whisper、Qwen、检索、存储和问答在所有者的计算机上运行，​​无需 AI API 密钥。
  • 忠实归因。 Discord 的每用户语音流会保留说话者 ID； Scout 不会通过分类来猜测说话人。
  • 有限保留。 两分钟的检查点保留结构化记忆，而不是隐藏的永久记录。 保留默认为 30 天。
  • 接地气的答案。 答案仅来自所选会话的保留内存，并包括大概的时间范围。 缺失的细节仍然缺失。
  • 本地语音问题。 在会议期间，说“嘿，斯库特”，等待嘘声，然后提出问题。 Scout 使用相同的接地当前会话查询路径，发布答案，并使用本地 Kokoro 神经语音在语音通道中仅说出直接答案。
  • 可检查操作。 仅环回仪表板显示会话、队列、模型、GPU、磁盘和保留运行状况，而无需发布对话内容。
  • 故障安全清理。 仅在验证并提交替换紧凑型内存后，才会删除临时输入。

它如何组合在一起

flowchart LR
    D["Discord voice"] -->|"per-user Opus"| N["Node.js sidecar"]
    N -->|"attributed PCM over authenticated loopback"| P["Python coordinator"]
    P --> W["faster-whisper"]
    W --> C["Qwen3 via loopback Ollama"]
    C --> S["SQLite compact memory"]
    S --> A["Grounded answers and summaries"]
    P --> U["Owner dashboard on 127.0.0.1"]
Loading

Node.js 适配器拥有 Discord 网关、应用程序命令、DAVE 语音接收和 PCM 解码。 Python 拥有生命周期、转录、压缩、检索、存储、保留和管理仪表板。 请参阅架构决策以了解这些边界背后的原因。

要求

Scout 目前的目标是一台所有者操作的 Windows 11 计算机：

  • Python 3.12（固定版本不支持 Python 3.13）；
  • 适用于具有 CUDA/FP16 的大型 v3-turbo 的 NVIDIA GPU（参考系统使用具有 16 GB VRAM 的 RTX 4080 SUPER）；
  • Ollama for Windows，绑定到环回；
  • Discord 应用程序和机器人令牌；
  • 固定的 Kokoro v1.0 FP16 本地语音模型（由 scout Warm-models 安装）；
  • 足够的本地存储用于模型、临时工作和保留的摘要。

签入的助手会为 Discord sidecar 下载固定的便携式 Node.js 24 运行时。 不需要在计算机范围内安装 Node.js。

快速启动

git clone <your-fork-or-repository-url>
cd Scout
py -3.12 -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -e ".[all]"
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\get_node_runtime.ps1
sidecar\.tools\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node.exe sidecar\.tools\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js --prefix sidecar ci
ollama pull qwen3:8b
scout warm-models
scout doctor
scout run

打开http://127.0.0.1:8765。第一次访问会创建本地仪表板密码。 然后按照 Discord 机器人注册指南设置 SCOUT_DISCORD_TOKEN 并配置所有者、行会、语音通道和输出通道。 完整的本机设置、打包和基准测试说明位于 Windows 指南中。

当缺少先决条件时，Scout 可以启动，但它会报告问题，并且在捕获和推理正常之前不会接受记录。

不和谐命令

命令 目的
/侦察开始（加入） 加入呼叫者的语音频道并开始会话
/侦察停止（离开） 尽早结束活动会话
/侦察状态 显示无内容会话和管道运行状况
/scout 摘要 [会议] 从紧凑的记忆中构建总体摘要
/scout Ask <问题> [会话] [范围] 问一个有根据的问题
/侦察会议 列出当前公会中可用的会话
/scout 导出 [会话] 在本地导出保留的摘要和元数据
/侦察正确[会话] 添加经过审核的更正

语音激活默认启用，可以在本地仪表板中禁用。 “Hey, Scout”这句话必须是说话者的全部话语；单独说“Scout”、在句子中提及 Scout 或在唤醒短语后提出问题都不会激活唤醒短语。 嘘声过后，该发言者默认有 20 秒时间开始提问，其他发言者无法接管待处理的互动。 唤醒检测使用配置的本地 Whisper 模型，因此必须以实际的对话轮次频率重新运行发布性能基准。 在口头问题或 /scout Ask 搜索活动对话之前，Scout 通过最新捕获的音频创建持久检查点，以便答案使用当前保留的内存。 发布的文本保留了近似保留时间的证据；语音播放仅读取直接答案。 Kokoro 通过 GPU 上的 ONNX Runtime CUDA 运行，可在仪表板中配置语音和速度。 Windows SAPI 仍然是显式的本地后备； Scout 不会默默地回退到 CPU 或自动切换引擎。

隐私和同意

Scout 明显地加入了语音频道，并在录制前发布了本地转录通知。 它使用通知和默示同意；不想参加的参与者可以离开。 记录法律因地点而异，因此操作员必须确认无论在何处使用 Scout，该模型都是合法的。

Data 地点 寿命
不一致的声音和消息 不和谐运输 由 Discord 和现场会议需求管理
原始音频和逐字记录 当地临时工作区 直到检查点持久提交
唤醒/问题剪辑和合成答案音频 当地临时工作区 本地推理/回放后立即删除
紧凑的内存和存在事件 本地 SQLite 数据库 默认30天，可配置
型号 本地盘 直到主人把它们移走
无内容的操作日志 本地盘 本地保留政策

运行时数据默认为 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Scout。 仪表板仅绑定到环回，需要密码，并使用 CSRF 令牌保护状态更改操作。 公会 ID 仍然是每个会话和检索边界的一部分。

发展

单元测试既不需要 Discord，也不需要 GPU：

python -m pip install -e ".[dev,audit]"
python -m pytest
python -m ruff check .
python -m mypy
python -m pip_audit --local --progress-spinner off
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\check_public_release.ps1

Node sidecar 测试使用下载的便携式运行时运行：

sidecar\.tools\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node.exe sidecar\.tools\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js --prefix sidecar test

表演释放门使用四个合成扬声器和一个三小时的课程；请参阅 Windows 设置。 真实的对话和生成的装置绝对不能提交。

欢迎贡献。 从 CONTRIBUTING.md 开始，阅读 AGENTS.md 中的项目约束，遵循行为准则，并根据 SECURITY.md 报告漏洞。
